exposure: mobile software app administration of CYRM-28
outcome: use of CYRM-28 in Scottish youth population
cohort: The participants were 714 students aged 11-18 years from two schools in North East Scotland.
finding: The mobile app version of the CYRM-28, featuring an avatar with an integrated voice guide, demonstrated higher test-retest reliability and similar psychometric structure compared to the paper version.
cross-section timing: Assessments were performed on youths aged 11-18 years, with retesting occurring 2 weeks after the initial assessment.
